text: Coccidiosis (from protozoan coccidia) is most common in young birds, with 3 weeks old being the highest-risk period. Affected birds show a characteristic posture — hunched up, fluffed feathers, drooping wings — plus soft mucoid or bloody diarrhea and strong thirst.
caveat: See also this bird's separate parasite-control entry for prevention/treatment products and dosing details.
